result.summary: No critical visual breakage found. Page renders correctly - header, search, categories, promo banner, carousels and tab bar are all intact. Only expected carousel peeking on the right edge and scroll-position cropping at the bottom are visible.

issues.description: Rightmost card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the screen edge - restaurant name shows as 'Trattoria Piccol' truncated mid-word and the '20-30 min' time pill is partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel peeking is intentional and that full name with ellipsis and full badge become visible when scrolled into view

issues.description: Bottom card in 'Popular right now' with '-20%' badge showing pizza image is cut off mid-image by the bottom tab bar with no restaurant name, delivery info or rating visible in this viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom scroll padding and safe-area inset so the last list item can be fully scrolled above the tab bar and is not obscured
